data.store_name: Powers Inn and Pub (The Barn at Power's remains open)
data.event_date: Thursday (exact calendar date not specified; keg cooler failure moved closure up from planned Saturday)
data.short_description: Owners announced via Facebook that after 15 years, Powers Inn and Pub in Halfmoon is now permanently closed. The Barn at Power's, used for events and catering, remains open and is booking through 2027. The property was listed for sale in May for $1.85 million.

Residents of Glenboro celebrated the official grand opening of the community-funded Spirit Sands Medical Clinic. The primary care clinic began accepting patients on June 8 and replaced a 70-year-old medical centre in the basement of the current Glenboro hospital.

data.location: Warrington Road, Bold Heath (former Griffin Inn pub building)
data.short_description: Hickory's Smokehouse is opening in the former Griffin Inn pub in Bold Heath on Friday, September 18. Reservations are now being taken, and the restaurant offers southern-style barbecue smoked using hickory wood.

True Fitness and True Yoga underwent a sudden closure, affecting a Singaporean actress who had a "lifetime" membership signed in 2017. Singapore's Fitness Alliance is helping nearly 235 affected employees find new jobs.

data.location: South Saginaw Street, Grand Blanc, Mich.
data.short_description: Anna's House, a West Michigan made-from-scratch breakfast and brunch restaurant, announced it plans to open its 14th location in Grand Blanc on Oct. 26. It will offer breakfast/lunch, gluten-free, vegetarian and vegan options, and expects to hire up to 60 employees.

Fill-A-Pita Mediterranean Grill, owned by Sultan Frehat, celebrated its grand opening with a ribbon-cutting on Sept. 9. Homewood Mayor Rich Hofeld participated, and attendees enjoyed free samples including pita bread, hummus, fries and falafel.

Lila's, a new all-day restaurant and cocktail destination from Rebees (the company behind GreenStreet), is set to open on the ground floor of 1201 Fannin St. this fall. It will feature an all-day New American menu and cocktail program led by chef Garee Battad and mixologist Zach Smigiel.
